conditions.B: E6 unmarked visible text after removal of mark-only IDs from D; fewer subject tokens
conditions.mid: Same visible unmarked text, deterministic early splitting to midway B-to-D subject-token count
conditions.early: Same visible unmarked text, deterministic early splitting to exactly D subject-token count
conditions.late: Same visible unmarked text, deterministic late splitting to exactly D subject-token count
conditions.D: E6 canonical marked visible text and tokenizer IDs; same subject-token count as early and late

outcome: Canonical gold-answer total log likelihood, no generation or accuracy endpoint
interpretation_limit: Forced BPE splits are off-manifold and change token identities with count. Equal-count early/late versus D still differs in spelling, tokens, and segmentation; no pure count effect is identified.
